att_earned_security.definition: The capacity to feel safe in a relationship, learned later in life rather than carried in from earlier life.
att_earned_security.example: Her earned security came from a relationship that stayed, after years of ones that did not.

dual_character.definition: What a person does as a rule, when nobody is checking.
dual_character.example: Character is what you do when nobody is checking.

lsc_openness.definition: The willingness to be known by somebody new, which is wider than being selective or not.
lsc_openness.example: Openness is not saying yes to everybody; it is letting one more person in.

socks.definition: Soft cloth you wear on your feet, inside your shoes.
socks.example: These socks are too big for me.
